sentences.text:
THIS APPEAL, COMING ON FOR ADMISSION, THIS DAY,
 JUDGMENT WAS DELIVERED THEREIN AS UNDER:
 -2-  NC: 2024:KHC:31696  MSA No. 39 of 2023 CORAM: HON'BLE MR JUSTICE V SRISHANANDA  ORAL JUDGMENT Heard Sri.V.B.Siddaramaiah, learned counsel for the appellant, Sri.T.P.Malipatil, learned Additional Government Advocate for respondent No.1 and Sri.K.S.Bheemaiah, learned counsel for respondent No.2.
2. Claimant is in appeal challenging the determination of the compensation in respect of the acquired land and 2 tamarind trees.
3. The following facts are not in dispute.
Land of the appellant in Sy.No.29/3C to the extent of 28 guntas of Kodiyala Village, Chelur Hobli, Gubbi Taluk was acquired for the purpose of construction of Hemavathi Canal.

4. Determination of the compensation by the Land Acquisition Officer, Reference Court and First Appellate Court are tabulated as under for the sake of convenience and ready reference:
NC: 2024:KHC:31696 Court Total Land - 28 Guntas & 2 Tamarind Trees SLAO Rs.450/- per Gunta & Rs.12,600/- for 28 Guntas Rs.6,493/- for 2 Tamarind Trees &
Rs.3,246.50/- for 1 Tamarind Tree Reference Rs.73,500/- for 28 Guntas of Land &
Court Rs.2,625/- per gunta Rs.7,450/- for 2 Tamarind trees & Rs.3,725.00/- for 1 Tamarind Tree.
Appellate Not enhanced for LAND Court Rs.11,425/- for 1 Tamarind Tree & Rs.22,850.00/- for 2 Tamarind Trees 5.
Being not satisfied with the same, appellant is before this Court.

6. Sri.V.B.Siddaramaiah reiterating the grounds urged in the appeal memorandum had sought enhanced compensation in respect of the acquired land as well as two tamarind trees by placing reliance on the judgment of the Co-ordinate Bench in MSA.No.135/2021 dated 06.02.2023.
Per contra, learned AGA for respondent No.1 and learned counsel for respondent No.2 support the impugned Judgment.

Sri K K Basavaraj vs The Special Land Acquisition Officer on 8 August, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/126651484/
2 8.

entities.text: Sri K K Basavaraj vs The Special Land Acquisition Officer on 8 August, 2024 Indian Kanoon
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Having heard the parties, this Court perused the material on record meticulously.
9. In respect of same notification and same project, the land of claimant in Kodiyala Village has been acquired.

In respect of C.Nandihalli Village, Chelur Hobli, this Court in the aforesaid Miscellaneous Second Appeal, enhanced the land value in a sum of Rs.6,000/- per gunta and in respect of tamarind trees, learned counsel for the appellant files a memo to withdraw the claim insofar as the tamarind trees are concerned.
10. Accordingly, taking note of the land value being settled at Rs.6,000/- which has become final in the absence of challenge by respondent No.2.
Appeal needs to be allowed by enhancing the land value in a sum of Rs.6,000/- per gunta in terms of the order passed in MSA.No.135/2021.

Hence, the following:
ORDER
The appeal is allowed in part.
Appeal insofar as the prayer for enhanced compensation in respect of tamarind trees is dismissed as not pressed.

Compensation in respect of the value of the land is enhanced to sum of Rs.6,000/-
per gunta with all consequential reliefs, less the payment of interest for the delayed period of 1064 days in filing the appeal.

Sd/-
(V SRISHANANDA) JUDGE NR/-
